about_the_game:
A New Kind of Puzzle Game!

Blast blocks with bombs and uncover hidden treasures!

- The Age of Interstellar Voyages -

In an ultra-advanced space civilization, humanity has surpassed the speed of light

and ventured into the vast, dark seas of the cosmos.

Newly discovered planets, one after another, captivate the curiosity of people,

and the research and exploration of these worlds have become grand entertainment.

Those who achieve great discoveries are rewarded with

immense honor and enormous wealth.

On this planet, Alesta, two adventurers with such dreams have landed.

Coco, the planet researcher. Orbol, the miner.

Now begins the grand excavation saga of this mismatched duo...

<Rules>

- Treasures of various shapes are hidden within the blocks.

- Use bombs to destroy the blocks and clear all surrounding ones to successfully excavate the treasure!

- But be cautious—if the blast hits the treasure, it will be damaged.

- If the treasure’s damage exceeds a certain level, the excavation fails.

- Excavated treasures will be recorded in your Treasure Compendium. Aim to complete the collection!

<Story Mode>

Experience the adventures of Coco and Olbol in Story Mode!

Uncover the secrets of Planet Alesta through excavation.

<Endless Mode>

Endless Mode allows you to endlessly clear stages and collect treasures.

Fill up the Treasure Compendium as you go!

<Challenge Mode>

Challenge Mode offers various stage rules to test your skills:

- High Score: Aim for the highest score possible.

- Speedrun: Clear stages as quickly as you can.

- Survival: See how many times you can clear stages before time runs out.

- Low Cost: Challenge yourself to clear stages using the fewest bombs possible.

★ Random Bomb Mode

In all Challenge Modes, you can enable “Random Bomb Mode.”

Using uniquely shaped bombs adds a fresh twist to the gameplay.

★ Online Rankings

All Challenge Mode results will be reflected in the online rankings.

short_description: A fresh and innovative puzzle game with casual controls and rules that still require thoughtful strategy. In addition to the short and accessible Story Mode, there are engaging features such as collecting treasures to complete the compendium, score attacks, and online rankings.
